overview.description: The Kurv Memory Select ETF (KMEM) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in information technology equity. The fund actively manages a global portfolio of stocks in the memory ecosystem, including companies that design, manufacture, and distribute memory chips. KMEM was launched on Jun 30, 2026 and is issued by Kurv.
